name: Ryan Muir
body: Pauly was a part of our movie group. We meet every couple months to discuss two movies everyone was supposed to watch.  It was always a surprise when Paul would show up, usually with no warning and a lot of times he hadn’t watched  the movies. He was a welcome face and a great addition to the conversation, movie knowledge or not.  It always felt like a big deal when he would show up for the meetings, and was only ever positive and easy to chat with.
